The '''Demophon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="S" /> located in the [[Demophon sector/Legends|Demophon sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> The system was [[Demophon supernova|destroyed]] when its [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Demophon (star)|Demophon]], went [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]].<ref name="EB">{{WEGCite|story=The Beginning of the End|book=Supernova (sourcebook)}}</ref>
